+import heapq
+from itertools import combinations

+def _route(data, minimum, exact, inclusive=True):
+    required = data.get("required", [])
+    bits = {node: 1 << i for i, node in enumerate(required)}
+    full = (1 << len(required)) - 1
+    start = data["source"]
+    initial_mask = bits.get(start, 0)
+    budget = data["coupons"]
+    graph = [[] for _ in range(data["n"])]
+    for edge in data["edges"]:
+        graph[edge["u"]].append(edge)
+
+    initial = (start, initial_mask, 0)
+    distances = {initial: data["start"]}
+    queue = [(data["start"], start, initial_mask, 0)]
+    while queue:
+        arrival, node, mask, used = heapq.heappop(queue)
+        state = (node, mask, used)
+        if distances.get(state) != arrival:
+            continue
+        if (node == data["target"] and mask == full
+                and (not exact or used == budget)):
+            return {"arrival": arrival}
+        for edge in graph[node]:
+            depart = max(arrival, edge["open"])
+            if depart >= edge["close"]:
+                continue
+            choices = [(edge["duration"], used)]
+            if used < budget:
+                duration = max(minimum, edge["duration"] - edge.get("discount", 0))
+                choices.append((duration, used + 1))
+            for duration, next_used in choices:
+                next_time = depart + duration
+                if next_time > data["deadline"] or (not inclusive and next_time == data["deadline"]):
+                    continue
+                next_node = edge["v"]
+                next_mask = mask | bits.get(next_node, 0)
+                next_state = (next_node, next_mask, next_used)
+                if next_time < distances.get(next_state, float("inf")):
+                    distances[next_state] = next_time
+                    heapq.heappush(queue, (next_time, next_node, next_mask, next_used))
+    return {"arrival": None}
+
+
+def _build_route(minimum, exact, inclusive=True):
+    return lambda data: _route(data, minimum, exact, inclusive)
+
